changelog:
• NetchSuite Sign-In: New login page with Continue with Google - sign in to sync your subscriptions as servers automatically
• Optional Account: Use this device offline keeps ZeroTrace fully usable without signing in, and any Xray config from any provider still works as before
• Smart Sync: Only active subscriptions become servers; switching accounts replaces the previous account's servers and expired plans are removed. Manually added servers are never touched
• Account Screen: Profile picture, name and LKR balance, opened from the round account button on the Home screen
• Secure Sessions: Sign-in tokens are kept in Android Keystore-backed encrypted storage
• Cleaner Server Cards: Full server names and a clear Synced badge
